title: The 4-Inch Window at America's Only Federal Supermax
asof: Figures from the 2018 DC CIC inspection · full video on the channel

shots.s: This is the only window you get for years.
It's in a cell at ADX Florence, in Colorado.
The window is about forty-two inches tall,
You can only see the sky.
Not the ground. Not the mountains outside.
The cell is seven by twelve feet.
The bed, desk and stool are poured concrete.
Most men spend at least twenty-two hours a day inside.
So that strip of sky is the outside world.
Could you live with a four-inch view?
